AUDIT Claude Opus 5.5 — growth-project-mobile#322 @ 8991ddf37ddc5488fc1448d5cdb6f3b04dc1af26 — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

**Opus A/B/C: 0/2/1. Full T4 audit at the live head, which is current with mobile main 0b7f197f. All findings are in this one pass.** I audited it together with backend #628 @ ba1d9480 ([verdict](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/628#issuecomment-5946454011)).

**What holds:**
- **Contract.** The client matches #628. `normalizeCardSetup`, `normalizeCardUpdate` (`card.last4` mapped to `card_last4`) and `normalizeCancelPlan` match the backend shapes, and an unknown outcome throws a shape error instead of guessing.
- **Money.** Amounts are integer minor units, shown with `/100` and the zero-decimal set (`formatDunningAmount`).
- **3DS.** `handleNextAction` runs and is followed by a re-confirm, capped at 3 rounds.
- **Lockout.** The `LOCKED_DUNNING` 403 reports once to the store, which drives one lockout screen with message-coach, export, delete and sign-out exits.
- **Links.** The universal link `billing/update-card` (alias `billing/update`) is wired, with the AASA entry and the Android filter in app.json.
- **Copy.** It carries the support address and reference.

### B: must fix
- **B-322-1: after a partial payment, the decline and processing copy says nothing was charged (mirrors backend B-628-2).** `cardUpdateOutcomeCopy` (`dunningErrorCopy.ts:331-337`) always says "...declined the payment of {due}, so nothing was charged", even when `amount_paid_cents > 0`, which happens when another delinquent plan was paid in the same confirm. `processing` and `requires_action` also ignore `amount_paid_cents`. **Fix:** when `amount_paid_cents > 0`, lead with "{paid} went through", then state the other plan's outcome. **Test:** a confirm response with `outcome: 'declined', amount_paid_cents: 15000, amount_due_cents: 9000`.
- **B-322-2: a lost confirm answer is reported as "nothing was charged".** In `describeDunningError`, `!e.response` (`dunningErrorCopy.ts:153-161`) returns "We could not reach the server, so nothing was charged" for `update_card`. That branch also covers an axios timeout or a connection dropped after `POST /payment-method/confirm` reached the backend, which may already have paid the invoice (1A). That breaks the "a lost answer on a payment never claims nothing changed" rule that #628 applies server-side (`unavailableMessage('invoice_pay')`). **Fix:** at the confirm step, say "We could not confirm whether your payment went through. Pull down to refresh; trying again never charges you twice", and refresh the dunning status. Keep "nothing was charged" only for failures before confirm (setup-intent, sheet). Apply the same rule to `cancel_plan` after a possible void. **Test:** a network error on confirm.

### C
- **C-322-1:** the End my plan confirm alert (`UpdateCardScreen.tsx:156-160`) promises "The unpaid {amount} is canceled ... Your access ends now". After the B-628-1 fix, a cancel that races a paid retry returns `scheduled`, so the access line should be conditional. The post-result alert already uses `cancelOutcomeCopy`, which is correct.

### Evidence at 8991ddf
- Read the full diff (27 files, +2935/−42).
- CI at this head: Typecheck, lint, test; CodeQL; Analyze (actions, javascript-typescript). All green.
- Merge state clean.
- I did not run the mobile suites locally; the CI run above covers them.
- Device acceptance is still required: PaymentSheet with this backend's ephemeral key (Stripe-Version `2024-09-30.acacia`), 3DS on a real card, and the universal link on iOS and Android.

AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-mobile#322 @ 8991ddf37ddc5488fc1448d5cdb6f3b04dc1af26 — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

**Sol A/B/C: 0/6/1. Full T4 audit, all findings in this one pass.** Read all 3,308 lines of the own diff, surrounding navigation/transport/store, the complete fix table and [Opus's exact-head verdict](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/322#issuecomment-5946462409), together with [backend #628](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/628).

The runtime native Stripe adapter, TGP-themed SetupIntent PaymentSheet, bank-confirmation loop, actual UpdateCard navigator route, universal/Android links, account-rights/contact exits, lockout suppression of competing paywalls and support-email rejection fallback are present; this is not a “missing native module” finding, and client dunning no longer mints a hosted billing portal. [Exact implementation](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/322).

### B — must fix before merge

**B-322-1 — Partial collections are hidden by the outcome copy (Opus B-322-1 independently reproduced).** `dunningErrorCopy.ts:299-337` computes `paid` but decline/processing/bank-action copy does not use it; decline says nothing was charged even when `amount_paid_cents>0`, and paid copy unconditionally says the plan is active instead of honoring unconfirmed restoration. Actual-function fixture with $100 paid/$100 still due rendered “nothing was charged,” a shape the actual paired backend produces. [Client money copy](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/322), [Opus finding](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/322#issuecomment-5946462409), [backend partial-payment boundary](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/628).

Minimal fix: always state known paid and remaining per-plan/per-currency totals before the later failure/action, and distinguish payment received/access still updating; regress first plan/invoice paid then decline/503/processing/3DS and failed access clearing.

**B-322-2 — Lost confirm response becomes a false no-charge claim; phase-dependent 503 mapping is broken at the real backend boundary (Opus B-322-2 extended).** `updateCard.ts:175-178` maps confirm errors with the same action as setup; `dunningErrorCopy.ts:153-160` treats any absent response as “nothing was charged,” drops operation context and does not report it. Actual native-flow fixture let the fake backend collect $100 before losing its confirm answer: result OFFLINE, no-charge copy, zero Sentry calls. Separately the production backend filter drops `step`, so `dunningErrorCopy.ts:265-287` maps uncertain `invoice_pay` 503 to “nothing changed” despite the backend's truthful human message. [Client flow/mapper](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/322), [Opus lost-answer finding](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/322#issuecomment-5946462409), [backend production envelope](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/628).

Minimal fix: preserve phase, SetupIntent/operation identity and last confirmed amounts; after an attempted confirm/bank/cancel, state uncertainty and reconcile before any new money action. Coordinate stable uncertainty codes/allowed phase with backend, distinguish actual network failures from unexpected thrown invariants, and report unexpected failures with a usable support reference. Regress commit-before-lost-reply and the real globally filtered 503, not only a fabricated Axios body containing `step`; do not promise retry safety from a new discarded action identity.

**B-322-3 — Initial bank failure discards the working recovery action it tells the client to use.** `updateCard.ts:158-172` has a known requires-action result/SetupIntent but returns only `{kind:'error'}` on a non-Canceled SDK error; `UpdateCardScreen.tsx:93-111,198-200,241-285` has cleared result and only renders Confirm with my bank when that missing result exists. Exact-function fixture returned BANK_CONFIRMATION_FAILED with no SetupIntent/result, while copy instructed “Tap Confirm with my bank”/“Use a different card”; the initial screen can only show Add a card. [Bank context and screen conditions](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/322).

Minimal fix: retain the saved card/action identity, latest bank-required response and secret in a recoverable result, then render a working bank retry and distinct new-card action; reconcile uncertain bank failures instead of asserting zero charge. Regress initial SDK Failed, retry Failed/Canceled, delayed successful bank return, and actual mounted button availability.

**B-322-4 — Native SDK promise rejections escape without human error, Sentry or reconciliation.** `updateCard.ts:132,164` awaits presentPaymentSheet/handleNextAction outside a catch; the screen callbacks (`UpdateCardScreen.tsx:107-145`) have only `finally`, including fire-and-forget autostart. Exact-function fixture with a rejecting native presentation promise rejected the whole flow instead of returning a user-facing error result. [SDK and screen boundaries](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/322).

Minimal fix: catch every native boundary, return phase-aware specific copy and a working next action, retain bank/operation context, report unexpected failures with reference, and refresh authoritative status where money may have moved. Regress init/present/next-action rejected promises, not just returned `{error}`, plus screen/autostart recovery.

**B-322-5 — Malformed successes clear lockout or manufacture usable payment results; unexpected local failures lack references.** `dunningApi.ts:50-69,125-166` normalizes malformed enabled status to `none`, missing/invalid money to zero and `requires_action` without its secret to a done response; `DunningLockoutProvider.tsx:84-90` then clears lockout. Exact-function fixtures accepted an unknown enabled state as `none` and an incomplete bank-action response as zero due/no secret; `dunningErrorCopy.ts:114-119,150-151` emitted an unexpected-response error with report=true but no reference. Even a supplied shape-error reference is assigned after the message was constructed, so the visible message omits it. [Normalizer, provider and reference handling](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/322).

Minimal fix: validate the complete usable contract and preserve the prior effective state on malformed success rather than claiming unlocked/zero debt. Keep safe HTTP/request correlation on shape errors; for unknown non-HTTP failures create a reference actually attached to Sentry/local diagnostic evidence and show it with the support action. Regress null/unknown enabled status, missing secret/money/currency, invalid cancel dates, omitted/supplied correlation and the real visible error.

**B-322-6 — The pre-payment amount can be stale, incomplete or absent while confirm charges more.** `UpdateCardScreen.tsx:53-71,114-118,142-146` builds “Save and pay {amount}” from a single status cycle and autostarts without waiting for a fresh payment quote; the paired backend pays all selected plans/open invoices. Its exact-service fixture showed status $100 followed by $200 collected; on cold status-null entry this screen can present “Save card” even though confirm collects overdue debt. [Before-charge UI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/322), [paired backend quote/payment boundary](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/628).

Minimal fix: fetch and explicitly show/approve a complete authoritative per-currency quote before PaymentSheet/pay-now, bind its immutable action/total to backend confirm, and refresh/reapprove changed debt. Retain multi-invoice functionality; regress two invoices/plans, mixed currency, null/loading status, stale status and concurrent retry.

### C — optional, carried

**C-322-1:** the initial End my plan confirmation (`UpdateCardScreen.tsx:156-159`) unconditionally promises access ends now, although a concurrent paid renewal should return option-A `scheduled`; use conditional wording without weakening the paid-period rule (same Opus C-322-1). [Prior exact-head observation](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/322#issuecomment-5946462409).

### Evidence and release boundary

All three mandatory exact-head checks SUCCESS; actual build execution **402 suites / 5,433 tests passed**. [Executed typecheck/lint/test](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/36968846394/job/110718370175), [JS/TS analysis](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/36968846437/job/110718370622), [actions analysis](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/36968846437/job/110718370336).

Independent `node ops/evidence/AUD-SOL-110/mobile322-boundary-probe.cjs` **exit 0**, six affirmative observations from actual native-flow/normalizer/copy functions with SDK/transport stubs; nonempty JSON, probe, source mirror, CI log and posting guard preserved under `ops/evidence/AUD-SOL-110/mobile322-*`. The screen consequences are direct state/render-condition review, not a falsely claimed React render or native-device test. [Candidate implementation](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/322).

Hold merge and activation pending this full fix set and the independent backend blockers; real iOS/Android PaymentSheet/ephemeral-key compatibility, 3DS/redirect recovery and universal-link acceptance remain required, and the account-export backend blocker is not waived by a Download my data exit. [Backend lens](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/628#issuecomment-5946454011), [export blocker](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/608#issuecomment-5945932895).

AUDIT Claude Opus 5.5 — growth-project-mobile#322 @ 0b4813dcfc37fbbeebd16283b1a326e9b8caa734 — VERDICT: APPROVE

Re-audit of S-DUNNING fix round 3 on the device (T4, money), paired with backend #628 @ `739e9a54` (APPROVE, [5957537166](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/628#issuecomment-5957537166)). I read my RC at `8991ddf3` ([5946462409](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/322#issuecomment-5946462409)), Sol's RC ([5946584922](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/322#issuecomment-5946584922)) and the R3 table.

**A0 / B0 / C1.**

### My findings, each closed with code and a test
- **B-322-1 (partial payment copy): CLOSED.**
  - `cardUpdateOutcomeCopy` (`dunningErrorCopy.ts:420-500`) is built from `paid_totals` / `due_totals`. The `declined`, `failed`, `requires_action`, `approval_required` and `payment_uncertain` outcomes all lead with "{paid} went through" when something was paid.
  - The titles become "Part of your payment went through".
  - "nothing was charged" appears only when `paid` is empty.
- **B-322-2 (lost confirm answer): CLOSED.**
  - `dunningErrorCopy.ts:195-204`: a missing response at `confirm_card` or `cancel_plan` maps to `RESULT_NOT_CONFIRMED`: "we cannot tell yet whether the payment went through… Trying again never charges you twice."
  - "nothing was charged" is kept only for `update_card` (before confirm, `:206-213`).
  - The 503 and timeout mappings depend on the phase (`:365-371`, `:383-395`).
- **C-322-1: CLOSED.** `endPlanAlertBody` (`UpdateCardScreen.tsx:95-100,256`) says "access ends now" only while a payment is overdue, and covers a payment landing in the meantime.

### Sol's B-322-3 to B-322-6: spot-checked in code; each covered in `nativeCardUpdate.test.tsx`
- **B-322-3 and B-322-4:** native SDK calls run through `guarded()` (`updateCard.ts:187,279`) and report to Sentry with the reference (`:103-106,242-245,285`). The bank-confirmation recovery is kept.
- **B-322-5:** malformed successes throw shape errors instead of clearing the lockout.
- **B-322-6:** the pay button is built from the backend quote, and the confirm sends `approved_invoices`.

### C (optional)
- **C-322-2: the `processing` copy leaves out money already collected.**
  - Evidence: `dunningErrorCopy.ts:444-445` says only "your payment of {due} is processing".
  - Backend `composeCardResult` ranks `processing` above `paid` (`client-billing.service.ts:903`), so plan 1 paid plus plan 2 processing shows no "{paid} went through" and no access line. The copy is not false, just incomplete.
  - Fix: prefix `${paid ? ` ${paid} went through.` : ''}` as the other branches do, and add one copy test.

### Seam, checks and evidence
- **The merge of main `c6b0fe3` has a conflict resolution in `src/services/api.ts` only** (`git show --remerge-diff`). It keeps both sides' imports:
  - `extractRequestId` and `dunningLockoutStore` from this branch;
  - `Alert` from main #313.
  No other hand edit was made. The head contains mobile main `e3986e89`, and its tree `99e1efe9` equals the merge-tree.
- **CI at this exact head:** Typecheck/lint/test, Analyze (javascript-typescript) and Analyze (actions) are SUCCESS.
- **Local**, via `heavy.sh` with `CI=true npx jest --runInBand src/entitlements/dunning`: **2 suites / 64 passed**.
- **Device acceptance is still required:**
  - PaymentSheet with the backend's ephemeral key;
  - 3DS on a real card;
  - the `billing/update-card` universal link on iOS and Android.

No push, merge, dispatch or production action by this auditor.
